From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@herculeshealth.com>

Cc: security@herculeshealth.com, procurement@herculeshealth.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: latest penetration test report for contract renewal / gating

Hi Sofia,

We're getting close to Hercules Health's annual renewal and procurement asked for the most recent penetration test report and a short remediation summary as part of their security gating checklist (MAP requirement). Could you please share your latest penetration test report and confirmation of whether any critical/high findings remain open? Procurement would like the artifacts and an owner for remediation before they finalize the PO on 12/12.

We can accept a redacted PDF if necessary and a simple CSV/Excel remediation matrix that maps findings to status and target dates. Also let us know if you have an SOC 2 attestation or SIG completed recently — that helps speed the review.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Account Lead, Hercules Health

[This message originated outside Redwood Inference]

To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@herculeshealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, thirdparty-testing@redwoodpartnerlabs.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report for contract renewal / gating

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads-up and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted PT report and a remediation matrix. A few notes up front so expectations are aligned:

- The most recent engagement was completed by Redwood Partner Labs (third-party) on 2026-11-18.
- There are two high findings affecting an internal telemetry ingestion pipeline; both are scoped for remediation but not yet closed. Target closure dates are in the remediation matrix below.
- We will provide a redacted PDF (no customer PII or internal IP blocks) and a remediation workbook that maps findings to owners and ETA.
- Rafael (Legal) — can you confirm whether Hercules requires a signed NDA addendum before we share the full PDF, or is redacted PDF sufficient under the existing MSA?

Action plan:
1) I will attach the redacted PT report (v1) and the initial remediation matrix by EOD today (Dec 5).
2) Monica will own coordination with your security reviewers for any follow-up questions.
3) We will provide weekly remediation status updates until the high findings are closed.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — legal here. No NDA addendum required for a redacted report that excludes customer PII and sensitive internal architecture diagrams. Sharing the redacted PDF and a remediation matrix is fine under the current MSA. If Hercules requests full, unredacted findings that include vendor-supplied test artifacts we will need to route that request through compliance and a data-sharing agreement.

Sofia — please mark the attachments as "redacted for procurement" and include a brief cover page that lists the redaction rules. That avoids back-and-forth with procurement.

Rafael Mendes
Counsel, Redwood Inference
